# WattPair — https://wattpair.com/
#
# Indexing policy is NOT carried here. Per-page <meta name="robots"> is the
# single mechanism, driven by src/lib/index-policy.ts, which also feeds the
# @astrojs/sitemap filter so a noindex page can never appear in the sitemap.
#
# Disallow is deliberately absent: a Disallow blocks CRAWLING, not indexing —
# a blocked URL can still be indexed from external links, and because the
# crawler never fetches it the noindex meta tag is never seen. Blocking here
# would defeat the very policy it looks like it is enforcing.

User-agent: *
Allow: /

Sitemap: https://wattpair.com/sitemap-index.xml
